rit_meaning: PDF version extracted from the file header.
rationale: CIC documents Header as presence of a valid PDF header, while RIT pdf_ver is a numeric extracted version. Header validity/version-like strings are not a version measurement and no deterministic conversion is documented.
rit_raw_semantics: PDF version extracted from the file header.
cic_documented_semantics: Presence of a valid PDF header.

rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "obj" in the PDF file.
rationale: CIC documents Obj as number of indirect objects, whereas RIT counts occurrences of the raw string obj. These are distinct parser-level quantities; similar names do not establish equality.
rit_raw_semantics: Number of occurrences of the string "obj" in the PDF file.
